lines.text: Jesus goes to the Mount of Olives, kneels a stone's throw from the disciples, and prays for the Father's will.
An angel from heaven strengthens Jesus, and in His anguish His sweat becomes like drops of blood.
Jesus returns and finds the disciples asleep, exhausted from travel, and tells them to get up and pray.
Judas comes to kiss Jesus, and a disciple cuts off the left ear of the high priest's servant, whom Jesus heals.
Jesus asks the chief priests, temple officers, and elders why they came with swords and clubs as against an outlaw.
